# ToolScout

> ToolScout is a directory that helps you discover, compare and choose the best AI tools for writing, images, video, coding, productivity, marketing, chatbots and audio.

ToolScout is an independently researched directory of AI tools, organized by category, with comprehensive reviews covering pricing, features, pros and cons, and real user sentiment sourced from G2, Capterra and Reddit. Every tool page includes a quick-facts summary, detailed feature breakdown, full pricing tiers, and an FAQ section.

## Categories

- [Writing & Content](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/writing-content.html): Draft, edit and scale blog posts, ads and marketing copy with AI.
- [Image Generation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/image-generation.html): Turn text prompts into original art, product shots and illustrations.
- [Video Generation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/video-generation.html): Create video, avatars and B-roll from text or a script.
- [Coding & Development](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/coding-development.html): Pair-program, autocomplete and ship code faster with AI.
- [Productivity & Automation](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/productivity-automation.html): Automate busywork and organize your work with AI.
- [Marketing & SEO](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/marketing-seo.html): Research keywords, optimize content and track rankings with AI.
- [Chatbots & Assistants](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/chatbots-assistants.html): General-purpose AI assistants for research, writing and everyday questions.
- [Audio & Voice](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/audio-voice.html): Generate voiceovers, clone voices and edit audio with AI.
- [AEO Tools](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/aeo-tools.html): Track and improve how your brand appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI answers.
- [Customer Support](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/customer-support.html): Automate customer service conversations, tickets and support workflows with AI.
- [Business & Sales](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/business-sales.html): AI tools for sales engagement, revenue intelligence, outbound, and go-to-market teams.
- [Data Analysis](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/data-analysis.html): Analyze data, build predictive models, and surface insights with AI-powered analytics platforms.
- [Design](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/design.html): Generate logos, graphics, UI mockups, and visual assets faster with AI-powered design tools.
- [No-code/Low-code](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/nocode-lowcode.html): Build apps, websites, backends, and automations without writing code, powered by AI.
- [Presentations](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/presentations.html): Generate polished slide decks, pitch decks, and infographics from a prompt or outline with AI.
- [Inventory Management](https://www.toolscout.in/categories/inventory-management.html): Track stock, manage warehouses and automate purchasing with AI-powered inventory tools.

## Tools

### Writing & Content
- [Rewording.io](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/rewording-io.html): Free AI paraphraser with an intensity slider and tone options — Free use is credit-based: 1 free credit as a guest, plus 50 more when you verify a new account; each tool run uses 1 credit. Paid options are pay-as-you-go credit packs (purchased credits never expire) or a subscription billed monthly, quarterly or yearly with unlimited use under fair-use terms. Prices for packs and subscriptions are not published. Checked on the official site 2026-11-11.
- [Jasper](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/jasper.html): AI agent workspace for marketing teams, with brand voice built in — Pro $69/seat/mo monthly or $59/seat/mo billed yearly; 7-day free trial. Business is custom pricing (contact sales, 12-month commitment).
- [Copy.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/copy-ai.html): GTM workflow automation with a small chat tier for writing — No free plan listed on the pricing page; Chat $29/mo ($24/mo annual); Growth $1,000/mo, Expansion $2,000/mo, Scale $3,000/mo (annual billing); Enterprise custom
- [Grammarly](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/grammarly.html): In-line grammar, tone and clarity checker, now part of Superhuman — Free plan available (100 AI prompts/mo); Pro $12/member/mo billed annually or $30/mo billed monthly; Enterprise custom pricing
- [Writesonic](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/writesonic.html): AI Search Visibility (GEO) platform with SEO content tools — Starter $79/mo, Basic $199/mo, Growth $399/mo (annual billing); Enterprise custom; 7-day free trial, no card
- [SummarizingTool](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/summarizingtool.html): AI summarizer for text, documents and video, with paraphrasing and AI-detection extras — Free with a daily request limit (number not stated); signing in raises the limit. Pro costs $4.99/month or $49.99/year (about 17% less), and unlocks every tool, unlimited AI words and no ads.
- [GoZen Content AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/gozen-content-ai.html): Budget AI writer and image generator for SEO blogs, social posts and email copy — Free $0 (2,000 words); Starter $19/mo; Essential $49/mo; Pro $99/mo; Premium custom. Yearly billing is advertised at 20% off. Prices from the official page on 2026-10-19.
- [Wordtune](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/wordtune.html): AI rewriting and tone assistant for confident writing — Free plan; Advanced $6.99/mo ($4.89/mo annual); Unlimited $9.99/mo ($6.99/mo annual)
- [Originality.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/originality-ai.html): AI content detector with plagiarism, fact-check and readability tools for publishers and editors — Free plan ($0) now includes the AI checker plus plagiarism, readability, grammar and fact checks; the page is inconsistent on free credits (60 renewing daily in the table, 100 one-time on the plan card). Pro $14.95/mo ($12.95/mo billed yearly, $155.40/yr) with 2,000 credits a month; Enterprise $179/mo ($136.58/mo billed yearly) with 15,000 credits and API access. 1 credit = 100 words. Verified on the official pricing page 2026-11-11.
- [Koala AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/koala-ai.html): AI SEO platform: an SEO agent plus KoalaWriter for bulk article drafting — Free trial of 5,000 words and 25 credits, no card needed. Paid plans per the live pricing page: Starter $25/mo, Professional $49, Boost $99, Growth $179, Elite $350, up to $2,000/mo (Scale III). Annual billing is said to save 20% but annual prices are not listed.
- [LanguageTool](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/languagetool.html): Multilingual grammar and style checker for 30+ languages — Free Basic plan (2,000 characters per text field, 3 AI rephrasings a day). Premium and Teams are billed monthly, quarterly, annually or every 2 years, but the live pricing page showed no amounts when checked, so current prices could not be verified. 14-day money-back guarantee.
- [Sapling](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/sapling.html): AI writing suggestions and language APIs, aimed at business and support teams — Free plan ($0, basic suggestions); Pro $25/mo or $12/mo billed annually; Enterprise from 10 seats at $15/seat/mo (quote on request); metered API with a one-time $5 minimum. Verified on sapling.ai/pricing on 2026-10-19.
- [AIPRM for ChatGPT](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/aiprm-for-chatgpt.html): Prompt library and prompt manager extension for ChatGPT and Claude — Free version available. Paid Solo and Team plans exist, but the live pricing pages did not show a complete price table when checked on 2026-10-19, so current plan prices could not be verified; the only figures seen were $10 (Plus) and $33 (Pro) in an example. See aiprm.com/pricing.
- [Contents.com](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/contents-com.html): Enterprise AI content platform for teams that need brand control and approvals — No public prices. The Plans page lists a single Enterprise plan with a Contact Sales call to action; a free trial button exists but its terms are not published (checked 2026-10-19). Older self-serve Free/Starter/Premium prices could not be verified and have been removed.
- [Keyword Caddy](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/keyword-caddy.html): Affordable local SEO and AI content platform for small service businesses — SaaS Platform $29/mo shown as billed annually (page claims it saves $120/yr; monthly/annual toggle with 25% off annual); 3-day free trial, no credit card required. Done-For-You is custom-quoted via a strategy call. Verified on the pricing page 2026-10-19.
- [Lavender](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/lavender.html): AI email coach that scores sales emails and, with Ora, drafts them — Email Coach has a free Basic plan ($0, 5 email analyses and 5 personalizations a month). Paid plans: Starter $27/mo billed annually ($29 month-to-month), Individual Pro $45/mo annually ($49 monthly), Team $89 per seat/mo annually ($99 monthly, demo required). Paid plans have a 7-day free trial with no card needed. Ora, the AI sales agent, is free to build and costs $500 per agent per month once launched. Verified on Lavender's pricing pages 2026-11-11.
- [MovableType.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/movabletype-ai.html): AI non-fiction book writer: idea to proposal, draft and marketing — Credit plans: Monthly $199/mo (10 credits, listed regular price $249), Quarterly $549 (30 credits plus 10 bonus), Yearly $1,999 (120 credits plus 25 bonus). One credit is one book generation; an audiobook costs 5 credits. A 14-day free trial is offered; its credit allowance is not stated.
- [NeuralWriter](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/neuralwriter.html): Free paraphraser with Light and Hard rewrite strengths in 30 languages — Free, no sign-up and no daily limit. Each run is capped at 10,000 characters (about 1,500 words). No paid plans are listed on the site; the Paraphrase API link had no pricing we could see.
- [NovelAI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/novelai.html): Subscription AI for anime-style image generation and collaborative story writing — Free Paper trial (50 text generations, 30 image generations up to 1024x1024 and 100 text-to-speech generations with a verified email). Paid tiers renew every 30 days: Tablet $10/mo (unlimited text and TTS, 1,000 Anlas for images), Scroll $15/mo (adds a larger context), Opus $25/mo (10,000 Anlas, 28,672-token context, free one-at-a-time image generation within limits). Extra Anlas can be bought on demand. Verified on NovelAI's official subscription docs 2026-11-11.
- [WordHero](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/wordhero.html): Marketing content workspace that turns one brief into emails, ads, social posts and SEO articles — Starter $15/mo, Pro $29/mo, Business $59/mo (monthly); yearly billing is $180, $348 and $708 per year. Every plan has a 7-day trial that requires a card. Checked on the live aivolut.com page; the page's stated yearly savings figures do not add up, so confirm at checkout.
- [Paperpal](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/paperpal.html): AI academic writing and research assistant from search to submission — Free plan available; paid plans (Prime, Pro) and institutional pricing exist, but current prices could not be verified from Paperpal's pricing page today. Check paperpal.com/pricing.
- [MailMaestro](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/mailmaestro.html): AI email assistant for Outlook and Gmail that drafts, replies and summarizes; Flowrite's email-writing product now lives here — 14-day free trial with all features, then a $0 free plan (limits not stated on the pricing page). MailMaestro paid plan: $12/seat/month billed annually ($144/seat/year); the monthly price is not stated directly (the page says annual saves 20%). Enterprise (100+ seats) is contact sales.

### Image Generation
- [Midjourney](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/midjourney.html): Image generator with a distinctive painterly look, paid-only — Basic $10/mo ($8/mo billed yearly); Standard $30/mo; Pro $60/mo; Mega $120/mo. Annual billing saves 20%. No free trial listed.
- [Adobe Firefly](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/adobe-firefly.html): Adobe's AI studio for images, video and audio, with commercially safe in-house models — Free daily generations; paid plans from $9.99/mo (Standard), $19.99/mo (Pro), $49.99/mo (Pro Plus), $199.99/mo (Premium)
- [Ideogram](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ideogram.html): AI image generator known for readable text inside images — Weekly free credits (amount varies); Plus $15/mo; Pro $60/mo ($42/mo billed annually, $504/yr); Team $30/user/mo ($20/user/mo annual); Enterprise custom
- [ImgGen AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imggen-ai.html): Browser-based AI image generator and editing toolkit on a credit system with rollover — Free (50 one-time credits, no card); Starter $9.99/mo (400 credits/mo); Pro $29.99/mo (1,400 credits/mo); Enterprise custom (contact sales)
- [Stable Fast 3D](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/stable-fast-3d.html): Open-weight model that turns a single image into a textured 3D mesh in under a second — Free under the Stability AI Community License for research and non-commercial use, and commercial use up to US$1M annual revenue; Enterprise License (custom pricing, contact Stability AI) above that. Hosted API credit pricing could not be verified.
- [Modelia](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/modelia.html): AI fashion model generator for e-commerce product photography — Free Starter (20 credits/mo, watermarked, 2K); Creator $30/mo; Atelier $109/mo; Brand $385/mo; House quoted per annual contract. Credit packs from $30 per 150 credits. Prices exclude tax.
- [Topaz Labs](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/topaz-labs.html): AI upscaling and repair for photos, video, and AI-generated media — Subscription pricing as listed 2026-10-20 (promotional prices change): Photo $39/mo, Gigapixel $29/mo, Video $59/mo, Studio $69/mo or $399/yr, Studio Pro $75/mo (12-month billing) or $799/yr; web plans from $12/mo. Some free web tools exist.
- [Meshy](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/meshy.html): Generate textured, rigged 3D models from text or images — Free plan (100 credits/mo, CC BY 4.0 output); Pro $20/mo, Premium $40/mo, Studio $70/mo + $10/seat, Ultra $100/mo; Enterprise custom (as listed on meshy.ai/pricing, 2026-10-20)
- [Pebblely](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/pebblely.html): Turn product photos into studio-quality scenes in seconds — Paid plans: Lite $9/mo (30 images), Basic $19/mo (200), Pro $39/mo (500); 2+ months free on yearly plans. Free plan/trial availability could not be verified on the pricing page.
- [PhotoPacks.AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/photopacks-ai.html): Studio-quality AI headshots from a handful of selfies — One-time $24 Headshot package (40+ images, no subscription); Teams pricing not published on the main page, could not be verified
- [Scenario](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/scenario.html): Custom-trained AI models plus 650+ image, video and 3D models for game assets — Free (50 credits, no card; personal/evaluation use only); Starter $15/mo; Pro $45/mo; Max $75/mo; Enterprise custom. Annual billing advertised as 33% cheaper.
- [BGEraser](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/bgeraser.html): Free browser background remover with no sign-up, batches of 20 — Web tool is free with no sign-up or usage limits per the site. Desktop app (Windows/Mac) prices could not be verified today; earlier listed as $5/month, $19.99/year, $29.99 lifetime.
- [Craiyon](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/craiyon.html): Free AI image generator with watermarked public output, paid for private use — Free plan (limited images, watermarked, public). Paid plans Supporter, Professional and Ultra remove watermarks and add private images and monthly credits; exact dollar prices could not be verified today (pricing page showed blank prices).
- [DiffusionBee](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/diffusionbee.html): Free, offline Stable Diffusion app for Mac — Free; no paid tiers listed on the official site
- [Dzine](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/dzine.html): AI design studio with many image and video models in one account — Free (100 signup credits, valid 12 months, no daily refresh); Beginner $8.99/mo ($7/mo yearly); Creator $24.99/mo ($20/mo yearly); Master $59.99/mo ($50/mo yearly); Master Pro $149.99/mo ($120/mo yearly); per-seat team plans.
- [Imagen AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imagen-ai.html): AI culling and editing that learns a photographer's style — Pay-as-you-go with $7/mo base fee that rolls over as export credit (AI color correction from $0.05/photo, other tools $0.01/photo); Limitless $129/mo billed annually or $165/mo billed monthly; Business custom.
- [Imagga](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/imagga.html): Image recognition APIs for tagging, moderation, and search — Free $0 (100 API requests/mo); Indie $79/mo (70,000 requests); Pro $349/mo (300,000 requests); Enterprise custom (above 1,000,000 requests). Verified on imagga.com/pricing 2026-10-20.
- [QuickQR.art](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/quickqr-art.html): AI art that doubles as a working, scannable QR code — Free plan (no credit card; QR codes, short links, link-in-bio page; AI codes are watermarked per earlier listing). Paid membership removes the watermark, allows commercial use and unlocks 1,000 AI QR generations per the FAQ. Exact paid prices and API credit-pack prices could not be verified today (pricing page failed to load); earlier listing showed $11/mo billed yearly and API from $0.0065-$0.009/image.
- [ThinkDiffusion](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/thinkdiffusion.html): Your own dedicated Stable Diffusion machine in the cloud — Hobby: no subscription, pay per machine hour (Quick 16GB $0.99/hr, Turbo 24GB $1.75/hr, Ultra 48GB $2.50/hr); TD-PRO $19.99/mo billed yearly or $29.99/mo monthly with 20% off machine rates; TD-TEAMS $59.99/mo; TD-EDGE price not public, contact sales
- [VectorArt.AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/vectorart-ai.html): Turn text prompts into scalable SVG vector art — Free tier (limited downloads, personal/educational use only); Premium $29/mo (up to 1,000 images/month); Unlimited $99/mo; single SVG download $4.99; 10-pack $14.99; API pricing not public — contact VectorArt.ai.
- [Vectr](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/vectr.html): Free cloud vector editor now supercharged with AI image tools — Pricing unverified today; site mentions free editor access with credits for AI tools and some imports

### Coding & Development

A $1, 3-day trial (card required) leads into $25/month or $99/year (about $8/month). - [AiPPT](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/aippt.html): AI tool that generates full PowerPoint decks instantly from a topic or outline — Free plan with 140 one-time AI credits. Plus gives 600 credits/month and Pro 1,200 credits/month. Dollar prices were not displayed on the pricing page we could load (aippt.com/price), so check it directly. A Lifetime Membership is mentioned without details.
- [AutoPPT](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/autoppt.html): AI presentation generator that turns prompts, documents, or PDFs into ready PowerPoint decks — Free plan (1 AI deck generation); Pro $19.99/month monthly or $12.49/month billed yearly; Unlimited $39.99/month monthly or $24.99/month billed yearly
- [deckrobot](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/deckrobot.html): Enterprise AI add-in that reformats and refreshes PowerPoint decks to brand standards — pricing not public — contact sales (site offers 'Book Demo' only)
- [Decktopus](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/decktopus.html): AI deck builder with a built-in rehearsal coach and trackable share links — No permanent free plan: new accounts get a small amount of free credits (enough for about a 3-slide deck). Pro $9.99/mo billed annually ($119.88/yr), $19.99/mo billed every 3 months, or $24.99/mo monthly, with 750 AI credits/mo (about 150 slides). Business adds team features and 1,000 credits per seat (price not listed publicly). Enterprise is custom. Students get 50% off.
- [MagicSlides AI PPT Maker](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/magicslides-ai-ppt-maker.html): Turns text prompts, YouTube videos, or documents into ready-to-use PowerPoint slides — No free app plan listed; Essential $8/month, Pro $16/month, Premium $29/month billed monthly (annual: $80, $149, $279 per year); optional one-time 'Done By Us' $99
- [Napkin](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/napkin.html): Turns text you have already written into editable diagrams, flowcharts and infographics — Free ($0, 500 AI credits/week, PNG and PDF export, Napkin branding on visuals). Plus $9/user/month (10,000 credits/month, PPT and SVG export, branding removed, 3 Brand Styles). Pro $22/user/month (30,000 credits/month, custom branding, font uploads). Annual billing saves 25%. Enterprise: contact sales.
- [Plus AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/plus-ai.html): AI that generates and edits slides inside Google Slides and PowerPoint — No free plan; every plan starts with a 7-day trial (1,000 credits, card required, new customers only). Billed annually per user/month: Basic $10 (1,500 credits), Pro $20 (3,000), Team $30 (6,000), Max $200 (unlimited). Monthly billing is $15/$25/$40/$240. Enterprise: contact sales.
- [PopAi](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/popai.html): AI presentation maker that builds decks from prompts, PDFs, Word, PPT files or web pages — Pricing not verified: the official site mentions a limited free entry option and plans that vary by AI credits, exports and branding removal, but the pricing page showed no plan names or prices when checked on 2026-11-03. Check popai.pro/pricing before buying.
- [PowerPresent AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/powerpresent-ai.html): AI presentation maker that hands you a real, editable PowerPoint file every time — Free plan (unlimited create/edit/present, watermarked PDF export); pay-as-you-go $1 per credit; subscriptions Starter $9/mo ($84/yr, 10 credits/mo), Pro $29/mo ($252/yr, 30 credits), Power $49/mo ($408/yr, 80 credits); Lifetime $499 one-time; Organizations custom pricing.
- [Presentations.AI](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/presentations-ai.html): Enterprise-grade AI presentation platform that turns ideas and live data into on-brand decks — Starter free (200 credits, up to 20 slides); Pro $20/mo billed annually ($240/yr, 5,000 credits); Gold $100/mo billed annually ($1,200/yr, 50,000 credits, includes Refresh). US prices; Enterprise/API/white-label pricing not public — contact sales.
- [Prezent.ai](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/prezent-ai.html): Enterprise AI platform for creating brand-compliant, story-driven business presentations — Lite is listed at $399 per user per month (plus taxes; annual billing saves 15%). Premium, Pro and Custom plans have no public price - contact sales. Free trial available.
- [Slidebean](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/slidebean.html): Pitch deck builder for startups, with optional paid advisory and done-for-you design — Free plan (no card, not time-limited) with basic editing; sharing, downloading and brand customization need a paid plan. Starter is $7/month billed yearly; Accelerate is $99/month billed monthly. Done-for-you design and fundraising services have no listed prices.
- [AI Presentation Maker by SlideModel](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/ai-presentation-maker-by-slidemodel.html): AI slide generator backed by SlideModel's huge professional PowerPoint template library — A free version exists with some free features; exact free limits and paid plan prices were not visible on the pages I could read - see SlideModel's Plans & Pricing page.
- [SlidesPilot](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/slidespilot.html): AI PowerPoint generator that turns PDFs, Word docs, links, and videos into structured decks — Free credits after sign-up with no credit card required; paid plans exist but I could not read the pricing page (blocked by the site), so current prices are not verified.
- [Text2Infographic](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/text2infographic.html): AI infographic generator that turns text, blogs, or files into shareable visuals in minutes — A few free sign-up credits (the site says 3 on the homepage and 2 in its FAQ), then a one-time Lifetime Access pass at $70 (shown as reduced from $120, with a 'limited offers' counter). Enterprise/API pricing is not public — contact sales.
- [Business Pitch](https://www.toolscout.in/tools/business-pitch.html): Turn a one-line idea into an investor-ready pitch deck — Free: $0 for 3 pitch creations per week. Medium: $6.99 for 35 creations, ad-free. Founder: $69.99 for 450 creations, ad-free, with weekly live pitch reviews. The plan page does not state the billing interval for the paid tiers.
